question: What is the highest energy per capita score in 2020? In which country
query: SELECT year, country_name FROM global_development_indicators WHERE year = 2020 ORDER BY energy_use_per_capita DESC LIMIT 1;
raw_results:
| year | country_name |
| --- | --- |
| 2020 | Africa Eastern and Southern |
answer: The highest energy per capita score in 2020 was in Africa Eastern and Southern.
